ApplyActor.description: Who asked for an `apply`. `at` is the daemon's local date, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

ApplyActorKind.description: A person, or the agent of a run.

ApplyParams.description:
`apply` params, and `preview`'s. `id` is left out for an op that makes a task, and `version` is the version the
caller last read: the source answers `conflict` when it has moved on. Only `args` is op-specific; its schema is
the op's `args` in `initialize`.

actor.description: Who asked. The daemon sets it from the connection. None is read as a person.

description:
`task.apply` params (`collide task <id> <op>`, `collide task new`, `collide task reid`, and the drawer's forms):
the provider's `apply` call, on one source. `source` is left out when the id names it (`plan:ts-0001`); an op
that makes a task has no id, so it names the source. `commit` makes a one-file commit of what the write touched
(`--commit`). Who made the write is the connection's actor, never a field here.
title: TaskApplyParams
